project.name: momu-agent-framework
project.description: An agent framework inspired by HelloAgents, providing multiple Agent implementations (SimpleAgent, ReActAgent, PlanSolveAgent, ReflectionAgent), a unified tool system with ToolRegistry and ToolExecutor, built-in tools (calculator, search, RAG, memory, note, skills, terminal), local memory system (working, episodic, semantic), RAG pipeline with document chunking and vector retrieval, context engineering via Gather-Select-Structure-Compress, MCP integration for stdio-based remote tool access, and OpenAI-compatible LLM support.

tour.title: Project Overview & Setup
tour.description: Start with the README and AGENTS.md to understand the project's purpose, architecture, and conventions. Review pyproject.toml for dependency structure and CI pipeline for quality gates.

tour.title: Package Entry Point & Configuration
tour.description: The package barrel (__init__.py) exports all public APIs. Environment configuration defines LLM, search, logging, and embedding settings.

tour.title: Core Abstractions
tour.description: Foundation of the framework: the abstract Agent base class, OpenAI-compatible LLM wrapper, Message data model with Pydantic, and typed exception hierarchy used throughout the system.

tour.title: Tool System Foundation
tour.description: The unified tool system is the central hub of the framework (highest betweenness centrality). Tool base class, ToolRegistry for registration, ToolExecutor for concurrent execution, and ToolChain for sequential orchestration.

tour.title: Built-in Tools
tour.description: Seven built-in tools covering calculation, search, memory operations, structured notes, RAG queries, skills management, and secure terminal execution.

tour.title: Tool Call Parsing
tour.description: The tool parser extracts and normalizes tool invocations from LLM text output using regex patterns, JSON parameter parsing, type conversion, and alias resolution.

tour.title: Agent Implementations
tour.description: Four agent strategies in increasing complexity: SimpleAgent (basic tool-calling), ReActAgent (reasoning-acting loop), PlanSolveAgent (plan-then-execute), and ReflectionAgent (iterative refinement). All share the common Agent base.

tour.title: Memory System
tour.description: Three-tier memory: WorkingMemory (short-term scratchpad), EpisodicMemory (past experiences), and SemanticMemory (knowledge facts), coordinated by MemoryManager. Built on a common Memory base with configurable backends.

tour.title: Storage & RAG Pipeline
tour.description: Three storage backends (Document, Vector for embeddings, Graph via Kuzu) support the RAG pipeline: document chunking/indexing, retrieval with sorting, and contextual Q&A aggregation.

tour.title: MCP Integration, Skills, & Context Engineering
tour.description: MCPClient connects to stdio-based MCP servers asynchronously, MCPToolAdapter wraps them as framework tools. SkillLoader scans local skills/<name>/SKILL.md with caching. ContextBuilder implements the GSSC (Gather-Select-Structure-Compress) pipeline.

tour.title: Examples in Action
tour.description: Demo scripts show how each component works end-to-end: simple agent, ReAct, plan-solve, reflection, memory tools, RAG tools, skills, MCP client, and the context-aware agent combining context engineering with the agent loop.
